title: Catalog launch ops lane and stakeholder guardrails for new model additions
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Objective: Define a repeatable, low-friction operational lane for getting new model additions from intake -> catalog listing -> public announcement. This ticket captures a granular checklist, stakeholder responsibilities, release-note drafting cadence, and guarded rollout gates for quality and telemetry.
tasks: PM: Finalize product brief and acceptance criteria for model variant (owner: Ben Carter) — deliverable: one-page brief with target personas and recommended default parameters
Research/Applied ML: Publish benchmark packet (owner: Dr. Lea Morales) — include latency p50/p95, throughput, embeddings/semantic similarity evals, and known failure modes
Engineering: Create runtime compatibility PR and smoke test matrix (owner: Priya Sharma) — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6124
Design: Provide example UI copy and model badge assets for catalog (owner: Marco Diaz) — deliverable: svg badges and microcopy for console flows
Docs: Draft user guide and quickstart (owner: Emily Ross) — doc draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Catalog/Model+Quickstart
Legal & Compliance: Review model license and data-use constraints (owner: Rina Patel) — outcome: approval or redline notes
Marketing: Prepare announcement assets and blog draft (owner: Sasha Nguyen) — marketing draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/marketing/model-launch
Sales/CS Enablement: Create one-pager and battlecards (owner: Marco Li) — include targeted objection responses and known limitations
Console/Observability: Create per-model dashboard template and create alerts for regressions (owner: Nikhil Rao) — dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/model-stats
Billing: Validate pricing and SKU mapping for hosted/dedicated/private (owner: Tom Becker)
checklist: Intake acceptance: brief + benchmark packet attached
Runtime compatibility tested on dev cluster: smoke tests pass
Canary plan documented with traffic split and rollback criteria
Telemetry dashboard created with p50/p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens
Release notes draft completed and reviewed by Eng/Docs/Legal
Marketing assets approved and scheduled in editorial calendar
Release gating: telemetry thresholds and customer impact plan signed off
Internal launch: enable feature flag for teammates and staff users
Public launch: catalog listing enabled, blog + changelog published
Post-launch monitoring window and rapid-response rota assigned
release_notes_drafts: Draft v2 (user-focused) — Emily Ross — awaiting design microcopy
Changelog entry (short bullet) — prepared by Ben Carter
